note: demo2d's night (PX7), for URP's 2D renderer. 'moon' is the global Light2D (characters and tiles are lit; effects are unlit). 'hero' is a warm light that follows the knight so he reads in the crowd (PX3's lineup). 'shafts' are moonlight shafts: freeform Light2D parallelograms falling to the south-east, at [x, y] ground positions in metres with a width and length, breathing slowly (period in seconds). 'fireflies' hover around the arena's trees: 'count' trees are drawn by seed, one firefly each, drifting within 'driftM' of a point 1 to 3 m up the trunk, blinking; each is a glowing dot and a small light. 'plants' lights the umbrella plants (their ids start with 'prefix') with a soft glow that pulses. Point lights for fireflies and plants are only placed in view, at most 'maxLights' each. 'post' is the present camera's post-processing on the 1080p image: bloom (threshold and intensity in linear HDR), a neutral tonemap, the colour adjustments, white balance, shadows lift and a vignette.
